name: dumbbell incline head supported row
description: A chest-supported row on an incline bench with your head resting on the pad. It targets the upper back without loading the spine.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your head on the top of the bench and let your arms hang.
Pull your elbows back and the dumbbells toward your ribs.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
